heading: Sunday
text: Mostly cloudy, chance of rain showers mainly south of Route 2 late in the day. Highs from the upper 50s, to near 60. Wind turning south at 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Sunday Night
text: Mostly cloudy. Rain showers spreading north overnight. Lows in the mid to upper 40s, near 50 around Burlington. Wind becoming light and variable.

heading: Monday
text: A few lingering showers in the north, dissipating by the end of the day. Highs from the low to mid 50s, nearing 60 in the warmer valleys. Light wind becoming northwest at 10 to 15 mph with 20 mph gusts.
